title: Business
cmd_admin: Open the player-owned business admin menu
gizmo_sign: Place the open sign (reads "Closed" as placed)
ui_craft_prop_hint: No stove or bench in the interior? Pick a prop and press Place prop: the station gets its own stove or table.
invalid_model: That NPC model doesn't exist. Check the NPC model field.
unavailable: This is not available right now
shop_empty: Sorry, we're sold out right now
staff_no_buy: Staff can't buy from their own business
no_permission: You are not allowed to do that
need_duty: You need to be clocked in here
not_enough_funds: The account doesn't have enough money
not_enough_stock: There isn't that much in stock
invalid_form: Something in the form isn't valid
db_error: Could not save to the database
max_jobs: You already hold the most jobs you can
cannot_take_job: That job could not be given
target_max_jobs: They already hold the most jobs they can
bought_business: You bought %s for $%s. Clock in at the manager's desk to get to work.
application_too_short: Write at least a sentence about yourself
application_cooldown: You applied here recently. Try again later
applications_full: This business isn't taking more applications right now
you_were_hired: You were hired at %s. Clock in at the manager's desk.
cannot_manage_grade: You can only manage staff below your own grade
withdraw_limit: You can only withdraw $%s more today
stocked: %s item types added to the shop
stock_returned: Items this shop can't sell were handed back
recipe_bad_name: The item name is too short or too long
recipe_bad_base: Pick a base item from the list
recipe_bad_ingredients: Pick 1 to the maximum number of different ingredients
recipe_limit: This business already has %s custom recipes
recipe_submitted: New recipe "%s" is waiting for approval
recipe_approved: Recipe "%s" was approved and can be crafted now
image_rejected: The image for "%s" was rejected, the base item's picture is used
image_rejected_upload: The image could not be verified and was left out
horse_too_far: Your horse needs to be right here
cannot_train: That horse can't be trained in this right now
training_request_sent: Request sent. A trainer will be with you shortly
training_request_no_staff: Request left. No trainers are on duty right now
training_customer_left: The customer is no longer here
tax_overdue: Tax of $%s for %s is overdue. Deposit money within %s days or the business is repossessed
wage_unpaid_owner: %s couldn't pay all wages: the account is empty
admin_bad_rooms: Room count is out of range
admin_need_craft: Add at least one crafting station
admin_rooms_note: Rooms that are rented above the new count stay until evicted (grumpy-hotel refuses the change until then)
dc_footer: React ✅ to approve or ❌ to reject
ui_already_applied: You've applied here already. Sending again replaces your application.
ui_apply_placeholder: Tell the owner about yourself and why you want to work here...
ui_duty_hint: Clocking in makes this your active job
ui_tax_repossess: Repossessed on %s unless the account can pay
ui_no_stock: Nothing has been stocked yet. Clock in and use the NPC to stock the shelves.
ui_stock_hint: Items without a price stay hidden. Prices: %s to %s
ui_training_split: The trainer keeps 60%, the business account gets 40%. Staff train free.
ui_wages_hint: Paid from the account every %s minutes to on-duty staff. Highest %s
ui_retire_confirm: Stop crafting %s? Existing items keep working.
ui_upload_hint: Or upload your own (png, jpg, webp up to %s KB). You can also paste an image with Ctrl+V.
ui_bad_image_type: Use a png, jpg or webp image
ui_image_too_big: That image is bigger than %s KB
ui_no_trainers: No trainers on duty right now
ui_request_waiting: Your request is waiting for a trainer
ui_reset_confirm: Take %s from its owner and put it up for sale? Staff are let go and the balance goes to the government.
ui_delete_confirm: Delete %s for good? Staff are let go, stock and stashes are lost.
ui_points_hint: Press Place. For the NPC (and hotel / stable spots), walk the ghost to the spot, turn it to face the right way and click. For the manager desk, crafting stations and stashes, aim the marker at the desk, stove or chest itself and click. You can close the menu at any time: /pob brings your unsaved changes back.
backroom_not_allowed: This kind of business can't have a back room.
backroom_bought: The back room is ready. $%s came out of the business account for "renovations".
backroom_none: You don't have a back room here.
launder_no_dirty: You don't have that much dirty money on you.
launder_limit: The books can only explain $%s more this week.
launder_limit_none: The books can't explain any more money this week. Sell more, or wait.
laundered: Washed $%s of dirty money. $%s clean cash is in your pocket to hand back, $%s went into the account as a private sale.
launder_failed: Your pockets are too full for the clean cash. Nothing was washed.
launder_tip: Word is dirty money is changing hands at %s.
warrant_description: Warrant to inspect the books of %s (owner: %s). Valid until %s.
warrant_issued: Books warrant issued for %s. Valid for %s minutes.
warrant_needed: You need a valid books warrant for this business and its current owner.
audit_owner_inspected: The law is going through the books at %s.
audit_owner_seized: The law seized money from %s's account.
seized: Seized $%s of laundered money for the government.
seized_partial: Seized $%s. The books show $%s laundered, but the account didn't hold enough.
ui_br_pitch: A back room lets you, and only you, wash dirty money. The fee is %s percent: %s percent is destroyed and %s percent goes into the account as a "private sale". You get the rest as clean cash. Staff only ever see the private sale.
ui_br_paid_from: Paid once from the business account. Lost if the business is repossessed or sold.
ui_br_buy_confirm: Pay %s from the business account for the back room?
ui_br_note: Hand over dirty money from your pocket. %s percent is destroyed, %s percent goes into the account as a private sale and the rest comes back to you as clean cash. Lawmen with a warrant can read these records and seize everything but the destroyed part from the account.
ui_audit_note: Laundering records from the last %s days. Older washes can't be proven.
ui_audit_open: Laundered (cash paid out + private sales), not yet seized
ui_audit_seize_confirm: Seize the laundered money from %s's account?
ui_draft_restored: Your unsaved changes are back. Save to keep them, or Cancel to throw them away.
gt_not_available: Gambling tables aren't available right now
gt_limit: This business can only have %s of these tables (placed and carried)
gt_bought: %s bought. $%s came out of the business account. Use it inside the business to set it up.
ui_gt_pitch: Card tables and a dealer's table draw a crowd. Buy one, then use it inside the business to set it up.
ui_gt_desc_pvp: Players against each other. Its cashbox collects half the house's cut of every pot.
ui_gt_desc_pvd: Players against the house. Its cashbox is the house: fund it to cover bets.
ui_gt_buy_confirm: Buy a %s for %s from the business account?
ui_gt_paid_from: Paid from the business account. Only you can place and manage your tables.
ui_gt_note: Tables use cash. A back room lets you run bloodmoney tables too.
ui_gt_note_backroom: With the back room you can choose cash or bloodmoney when you place a table.
gt_item_missing: The table item isn't set up on this server yet (tell an admin)
gt_too_heavy: You're carrying too much to take a table
